{{short description|Reciprocity law related to class numbers of quadratic number fields}}
In [[mathematics]], '''Yamamoto's reciprocity law''' is a [[reciprocity law]] related to [[Ideal class group|class number]]s of [[quadratic number field]]s, introduced by {{harvtxt|Yamamoto|1986}}.
